text:
mia: Heads-up — saw left nav showing another workspace's saved filters after a quick org switch in prod this morning. Repro steps: login as user A -> switch org from X -> Y -> back to X quickly (~1s) -> left nav shows Y's filters. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/leftnav-leak.png :eyes:
sam: repro'd in staging too. Not always, maybe timing/race. Steps I used: open /console, click org switcher twice fast. I got Y's 6 filters inside X's sidebar.
ash: that sounds like the prefetch cache is keyed by user only. we used `cache.set("leftnav_prefetch_v1:" + userId, payload)` in prefetchtasks service. if orgId is missing from key it'll serve the wrong blob on quick switches.
ash: log snippet from staging when i repro'd: `INFO prefetch: cache_hit leftnav_prefetch_v1:uid123 user=uid123 org_current=orgX payload.org=orgY`
lina: yikes. that log shows payload.org != org_current. could be race when prefetch for orgY finishes after UI already switched back to X.
ash: quick fix options: 1) include orgId in cache key (leftnav_prefetch_v1:{user}:{org}) 2) add validation on read (discard payload if payload.org != currentOrg) 3) turn off client-side nav caching until we fix runway.
jordan: prefer 1 + 2. adding org to key is straightforward and avoids wasted validation cost, but validation guard is good defense-in-depth. plan: patch prefetchtasks to namespace by org, add guard on read, deploy canary to 10% traffic.
mia: assigning ownership: I'll take the patch + canary. putting a short-lived feature flag so we can flip if anything regresses. created ticket RED-8421 https://redwood.internal/issue/RED-8421 — please add notes. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Incident created: RED-8421 (leftnav: prefetch cache missing org key) — severity P2.
lina: we should also add telemetry to catch this automatically: metric `leftnav.prefetch.cache_mismatch` increment when payload.org != currentOrg, and alert if > 5/min.
sam: will add lightweight alert on the dashboard (dash id dsh-238) and add a log-based monitor for the `cache_mismatch` message.
jordan: about rollout, recommend: 1) patch in prefetchtasks repo 2) unit + integ that simulates quick org switch 3) deploy to staging, validate dashboard 4) canary 10% prod 1h, then 50% 1h, then 100% if stable.
mia: patch branch ready: https://git.redwood.internal/prefetchtasks/leftnav-orgkey. PR description has test vectors. Requesting review from @ash and @jordan.
ash: quick sanity check: also verify eviction TTLs — if we namespace by org we may spike cache cardinality for heavy users. probably fine but add a metric `leftnav.cache.entries` to track.
lina: noted. i'll add both metrics to the Console observability board and a small runbook entry for RED-8421.
mia: immediate mitigation: rolling feature flag to disable client caching for 15m while we land the patch. doing that now. will post canary status. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: leftnav_client_cache=false (target: all) — roll executed by mia at 1766667915.
mia: canary started at 1766667920 on 10% of traffic. initial checks look clean in logs, no increase in latency. will update after 30m.

(Short thread — moving the ticket with more details. will follow up with postmortem if we see any customer impact.)
